item.title: Earlier teen curfew considered to prevent Virginia Beach spring beach parties
item.description: Virginia Beach is considering it's options to prevent unsanctioned beach parties this spring now that a General Assembly bill that would have given police departments broader authority to enforce laws during unsanctioned "pop-up" events is off the table.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 10, 2026

item.title: CNU men’s basketball team climbs to No. 8 in country
item.description: CNU junior Toa Hollenbeck, a Grassfield High graduate, was named the Coast-To-Coast Athletic Conference Player of the Week after his Freeman Center-record 43-point outburst in a win against then-No. 2 Mary Washington.
